snippet.title: Fata Deum - The God Sim | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to PC on 15th September 2025!

Inspired by classic god simulation games, Fata Deum lets you shape the fate of mortals with your divine hand. Be good or be bad. Raise or ruin. Foster or frighten. With the power of a deity – what kind of god will you be?

Wishlist now on Steam 👉 https://links.aerosoft.com/FataDeum
Join the official Discord 👉 https://discord.gg/UWhqDf4fdX
